decisions.reason: Although distant from the core and only mentioned on the website, the recruitment service uses the firm's existing crewing infrastructure, so little is lost by keeping it and nothing about its results has yet forced a write-off.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing network, and nothing points to disappointing results, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The BSM Smart Academy has a page of its own, was launched publicly, and has a growing network of partner institutions, so a visible commitment and investment make keeping it very likely.
FuelEU monitoring and compliance services are regulatory-driven, central to the announced environmental direction, and showed demonstrable success, so they will be kept.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and supports the publicly committed FuelEU offering, so dropping it would write off the investment.
The cost simulator is embedded in PAL alongside the dashboard and serves the strategic emissions-compliance push, which gives strong reasons to persist with it.
